name: kan-tools
description: Plugins from the kan-tools projects: a memory substrate and the process layer that sits on it.

plugins.name: kan
plugins.description: Local-first, provenance-preserving memory substrate for AI agents. Ships the kan MCP server; no commands or hooks of its own.

plugins.name: day
plugins.description: Structured process layer for AI-assisted development: teloi, composable process atoms, and drift assessment, all recorded in kan. Ships the /design, /adversarial-review, /handoff, /wakeup and /witness-interview commands, plus SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks.
